problemsFound: Gap claiming curl/HEAD gets 'Empty reply from server' is out of date. On 2026-10-27, plain curl with a desktop UA returned HTTP 200 for the homepage and all subpages, and 200/206 with correct image content-types for every logo and photo URL. Live status, type and dimensions were verified directly, so that gap was removed.

The case-studies about item cited /seated-meals/ for everything. Only the Alleyn Court ball (224 guests, 2010) is there. The 122- and 113-guest marquee weddings (Ingatestone Hall) are on /weddings/, and the 170-guest Beaconsfield venue-opening lunch (5 June 2009) is on /corporate-events/. Split the item and fixed the sources.

The wedding service merged two pages. Themed weddings and glassware/cutlery/tableware/linen options come from the /weddings/ events page, not /menus/weddings/. The quoted tasting term was cut short. The full text is 'The tasting is complimentary for the bride and groom (there is an additional charge for extra guests) for weddings over 60 guests'. The menu included-list also covers glassware up to speeches, beverage staff up to speeches and a full kitchen team.

The WP media library and gallery hold own landscape shots 2017-03-16-PHOTO-00000030.jpg (1600x1200, prawn and mango skewers) and 2017-03-16-PHOTO-00000037-1.jpg (1276x500, mezze dips board). Also missed: higher-res own images mezze.jpg (1200x1600), PHOTO-00000039 (1112x1600), an Instagram-origin dessert photo (1080x1080) and Special-Events.jpg (896x896). The image list was rebuilt around these.

identity.evidence: The live homepage footer (fetched with curl on 2026-10-27, HTTP 200) gives exactly the directory address: 'Unit 4, Hastingwood Business Centre, Hastingwood, Essex CM17 9GD'. The trade matches: the site says 'Magpie Catering are a professional events catering service ... Based in Hastingwood, Essex serving the South East of England.' The FSA food hygiene register (FHRSID 716530) lists 'Magpie Catering' at Unit 4 Hastingwood Business Centre, Willow Place, Harlow CM17 9GD as a mobile caterer. Companies House lists MAGPIE CATERING LIMITED (06203649), active, SIC 56210 Event catering activities, incorporated 4 April 2007 (formerly Vellveda Associates Ltd until May 2008). Its active director is Elizabeth Jane Joyce, matching 'Elizabeth Joyce, Managing Director' quoted on the homepage. Wayback captures of magpiecatering.com go back to April 2005. The Jan 2014 capture links twitter.com/MagpieCatering1 and a Facebook page titled 'Hastingwood/Magpie-Catering'. The year differs across the site: About says 'since 1995' (matches the directory), the homepage body and footer say 1985, and the MD quote says 1994. Namesakes ruled out: Magpie Café (Whitby), Magpie (Heddon St, London), The Magpie Bakery (US), Magpie Sacramento, Two Magpies Bakery.

about.text: Magpie Catering describes itself as a professional events catering service based in Hastingwood, Essex, serving the South East of England.

It offers outside catering for weddings, gala dinners, business lunches, corporate events, conferences, birthdays, anniversary parties, funerals, christenings, reunions, graduations and other celebrations. Menu styles include canapés, bowl food, buffets, BBQs, mezze, seated meals and private fine dining.
Managing Director Elizabeth Joyce says the business grew out of a restaurant she part-owned with her father. It started by catering small weddings and events such as funerals.

The About page names that restaurant as The Magpies Nest Restaurant, Epping. It says Elizabeth (Lizzy) Joyce won a Young Business Person of the Year award in 1997 at the Essex Business Excellence Awards (NatWest Bank and Epping Forest District Council), for the restaurant and her outside catering service.
The About page says Magpie has catered throughout the South East since 1995. It caters at any venue, marquee or home, for any occasion and any number of guests.

Service ranges from delivered buffets to fully staffed, managed events, and the company brings all the catering equipment needed. Weddings and large events are offered a pre-event tasting, and regular corporate clients can ask for a sample buffet.

The About page lists the team: an operations and executive events manager (since 2008), an events manager and chef (since 2009), a head chef (with Magpie since 1998), a chef and an office manager. Waiting staff are trained in-house and work in uniform.

Seated-meal dishes are designed to work on location, from a small dinner party to a ball for 2,000. Menus include qualified chefs, personal events managers, trained waiting staff, cutlery, china, table laying and table plans.

The company describes its menus as globally influenced (English, Asian, Italian, French and others) with a modern approach. It says it follows food trends and researches new products at trade and food shows.
A seated-meals case study covers the Alleyn Court Preparatory School Summer Ball 2010 in Southend-on-Sea: a champagne and canapé reception and a three-course seated meal for 224 guests.
Wedding case studies include marquee weddings for 122 day guests and for 113 guests, the latter at Ingatestone Hall. A third is a 114-guest seated wedding at Sutton Hall Farm, Rochford.
A corporate case study covers a celebrity venue-opening lunch on 5 June 2009 in a marquee at a new corporate building in Beaconsfield, Bucks. Canapés and bowl food were served to 170 guests.
The FSA food hygiene register lists Magpie Catering (Unit 4 Hastingwood Business Centre, CM17 9GD) as a mobile caterer with a food hygiene rating of 5. The latest inspection was on 19 January 2026.
The operating company, Magpie Catering Limited (company no. 06203649), is active and was incorporated on 4 April 2007. Its nature of business is event catering activities (SIC 56210).

services.name: Wedding catering
services.description: Weddings come with a personalised menu, ranges of glassware, cutlery, tableware and linen, menu tasting and full event management. Themed weddings range from traditional English country garden to East End or modern contemporary.

services.name: Wedding menus
services.description: Wedding menus cover cold and hot canapés, starters, mains, a children's menu, desserts and trios of dessert, and evening buffets A–M (including bagels, street food, bowl food, deli and BBQ). Included: a three-course sit-down meal with coffee and luxury chocolates, pre-ordered menu choice, a dietary/allergen option, cutlery, crockery, glassware up to speeches, a personal events manager, waiting and beverage staff up to speeches, a full kitchen team, and laying up of the room or marquee. Published terms (verbatim): "This pricing structure is based on events over 40 guests. Please ask for a bespoke quotation for numbers below 40 guests." and "The tasting is complimentary for the bride and groom (there is an additional charge for extra guests) for weddings over 60 guests". Linen, kitchen equipment hire and after-dinner drinks service are extra. No per-head price is published.

services.name: Seated menus (summer balls, gala dinners, corporate)
services.description: A bespoke seated menu (Options A, B and C) with a canapé selection and gluten- and dairy-free alternatives. Included: a three-course meal with coffee and luxury chocolates, cutlery, crockery, a personal events manager, waiting staff, beverage staff for reception drinks, a full kitchen team, and laying up of the room or marquee. Published price text (verbatim): Fillet Steak main "@ £4.00 per person extra"; "This pricing structure is based on events of 60 guests. Please ask for a bespoke quotation for numbers above or below". Linen, equipment and beverage service through the meal are quoted separately.

services.name: Canapé receptions
services.description: 17 cold canapés, 26 hot canapés and 26 sweet finger desserts. They are cooked by your own personal chef and walked around guests by uniformed staff.

services.name: Bowl food
services.description: Standing-reception dishes served in 4" bowls with a fork. Savoury sections cover pork and sausage, chicken, beef, lamb, duck and game, fish, vegetarian and salads, followed by dessert bowls and sweet finger desserts.

services.name: BBQs
services.description: BBQ menus use high-quality meat from a local supplier and run from British-themed to Mediterranean. Options include sharing starter boards and antipasti, a children's BBQ menu, a build-your-own burger station, a Turkish shish station, and a menu with whole lamb shoulder carved from the BBQ and seasoned sirloin steaks. Guests watch the chefs cook.

services.name: Mezze (Turkish)
services.description: A Turkish-inspired mezze menu. Guests choose five items from cold and hot sharing-board lists, served with breads. The main is lamb or chicken shish or vegetable moussaka with tabbouleh, ezme and cacik. Dessert is pistachio and walnut baklava, Turkish milk custard phyllo pies and Turkish delight.

services.name: Finger buffets (delivered)
services.description: Freshly prepared, garnished finger buffets delivered ready to serve. Options include afternoon-tea menus on traditional cake stands, a children's buffet, a gluten- and dairy-free menu, a chef's cake selection and sweet finger desserts. Published charges (verbatim): "Food delivery (free within 7 miles of our kitchens – anything over 7 miles is charged at 85p per mile)"; "Minimum order of 15 guests"; matching black plate and napkin "@ 35p"; china, wood and slate platters "would carry a 50p per person supplement to menu price"; "Waiting/Drinks Staff (if required) are charged at £12.50 p/h"; "A 25% non-refundable deposit secures your booking"; "All prices within the brochure are subject to VAT at the current rate". No per-head buffet prices are published.

services.name: Corporate finger buffets & lunches
services.description: Corporate catering from breakfast meetings to large functions, planned with event co-ordinators. Numbered finger-buffet menus include a Healthy Finger Menu and a gluten- and dairy-free menu, with optional front-of-house staff. Published terms (verbatim): "Minimum order of £42.50"; delivery "anything over 7 miles is charged at 85p per mile"; plate and napkin "@ 35p"; "We ask for three working days' notice for your bookings"; "All prices within the brochure are subject to VAT at the current rate".

services.name: Cold & hot fork buffets
services.description: A less formal alternative to a plated meal, with many choices and themed options. Supplement dishes are marked, cheese platters are available, and staff and a coffee and tea service can be added.

services.name: Corporate event catering
services.description: Catering for meetings, gala balls, new product launches, premises moves, working lunches, directors' dining, client entertaining and AGMs. Formats include seated meals, canapé receptions, finger buffets, hot fork buffets, bowl food, BBQs and hog roasts, with help on planning and logistics.

services.name: Private fine dining
services.description: A dinner-party service in the client's home for six or more guests. An executive chef advises on the menu, and on the day a personal chef and a member of the waiting staff serve. Magpie brings all equipment and lays the table.

services.name: Special events & celebrations
services.description: Menus for any celebration, at home, in a marquee or at a hired venue. Styles include seated meals, cocktail parties, canapé receptions, finger buffets, hot fork buffets, bowl food, BBQs and hog roasts. Case studies include a family reunion garden party, an 18th birthday at home and a 30th wedding anniversary ball.

services.name: Funeral catering
services.description: Funeral catering at short notice with caring, sensitive staff and dedicated menus. Beverages and beverage service, glassware, linen, and hall setting-up and clearing can also be arranged.

record.instagramAccess: The live site's header and footer link to https://www.instagram.com/magpie.catering/. One plain unauthenticated GET (desktop Chrome UA, no cookies) on 2026-10-27 returned HTTP 200 and about 505 KB of HTML. The page was a generic shell titled 'Instagram' whose route config shows "pageID":"httpErrorPage", with no profile data (no bio, follower count or posts). This is a logged-out error page or login wall, or the handle no longer resolves. It was not retried. One plain GET to https://en-gb.facebook.com/MagpieCateringPage/ (the URL the site links) returned HTTP 400 (title 'Error', 1,542 bytes).
gaps: No own video footage found. All 19 fetched site pages (home, about, events, gallery, every menu page, contact) have no <video>/<source>, .mp4/.webm, or YouTube/Vimeo iframes. The WP media library (129 items) has only jpeg/png/gif, no video mime types. No YouTube, Vimeo or TikTok channel is linked, and site-restricted searches found only unrelated 'Magpie' videos. Facebook may hold videos but needs login and was not accessed. A hero showreel can't be built from verified own footage.

Establishment year conflicts on the business's own site. The About page says 'since 1995' (matches the directory). The homepage body says 'recognised throughout the South East ... since 1985' and the footer says 'established in 1985'. The MD's quote says 'Since starting Magpie in 1994'. The limited company was incorporated in 2007 (as Vellveda Associates Ltd, renamed 2008). Confirm with the business before publishing a year.

The directory price '£500 per head' is not supported. The site publishes no per-head menu prices (a wedding tasting no-show charge appears as 'per person plus VAT' with the figure blank). It only lists ancillary charges: delivery 85p/mile beyond 7 miles, staff £12.50 p/h, 35p plate/napkin, 50p pp china supplement, £4.00 pp fillet-steak supplement, minimum order 15 guests (buffets) or £42.50 (corporate), and a 25% deposit. Treat the directory figure as a data-entry error.

No SVG logo exists. The best transparent lockup is the 680x410 PNG and the best icon mark is the 512x512 PNG. A larger crisp lockup would need a faithful vector reconstruction, with provenance noted.

Instagram @magpie.catering returned a logged-out error shell, so whether it is active is unverified. twitter.com/MagpieCatering1 was linked from the site in Jan 2014 (Wayback) but not from the current site, and its activity was not checked. x.com/Magpie_Catering surfaced only in search results, is not linked from any Magpie page checked, and was not verified, so it is omitted.

Event-type sources: Weddings, Corporate Events, Birthday Parties and Anniversaries are on the homepage. Product Launches ('a new product launch') come from /corporate-events/, Garden Parties from the 'Family Tree Reunion and Garden Party' case study on /special-events/, and Private Parties from /private-fine-dining/ (dinner parties at home). Event types they serve with no taxonomy match: funerals, christenings, reunions, graduations, conferences, gala dinners and balls.
